title: Cybermaps AI configuration changes
description: A merge-only set of reviewed Cybermaps configuration changes. Null and omitted values preserve the destination.

core_settings.title: Core Settings
core_settings.description: XML, RSS, media, language, notification, and HTML sitemap behavior.

site_language.title: Site language
site_language.description: Sets the canonical BCP 47-style hreflang code used in sitemap and discovery output. A blank editable value inherits the WordPress site language; en is the final fallback. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

sitemap_url_base.title: Sitemap URL base
sitemap_url_base.description: Sets the collision-safe public base slug for the primary XML sitemap. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

include_homepage.title: Include homepage
include_homepage.description: Includes the homepage in the miscellaneous XML sitemap. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

include_authors.title: Include author archives
include_authors.description: Includes public author archives in the sitemap inventory. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

include_archives.title: Include date archives
include_archives.description: Includes date archive pages in the sitemap inventory. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

include_empty_terms.title: Include empty terms
include_empty_terms.description: Allows empty public taxonomy terms to appear in sitemap output. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

update_comment_post.title: Comments update post modified time
update_comment_post.description: Updates a post modified timestamp when it receives a comment. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

update_comment_page.title: Comments update page modified time
update_comment_page.description: Updates a page modified timestamp when it receives a comment. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

inject_robots.title: Advertise publications in robots.txt
inject_robots.description: Adds Cybermaps sitemap and discovery locations to the virtual robots.txt response. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_caching.title: Cache dynamic sitemap responses
enable_caching.description: Caches dynamically generated sitemap responses until relevant invalidation. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_translation_integrations.title: Translation integrations
enable_translation_integrations.description: Uses supported multilingual plugins to publish alternate-language sitemap relationships. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

external_sitemaps.title: External sitemap references
external_sitemaps.description: Adds up to 100 unique absolute public HTTP or HTTPS URLs whose path ends in .xml to the sitemap index, one per line. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

external_pages.title: External pages
external_pages.description: Adds up to 1000 unique absolute public HTTP or HTTPS non-WordPress page URLs to the miscellaneous sitemap, one per line. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

exclude_post_ids.title: XML excluded post IDs
exclude_post_ids.description: Lists positive post IDs omitted from standard XML sitemap children. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

exclude_categories.title: XML excluded categories
exclude_categories.description: Lists positive category IDs or canonical non-numeric slugs omitted from standard XML sitemap children. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_indexnow.title: IndexNow notifications
enable_indexnow.description: Notifies configured IndexNow services after eligible content changes. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_websub.title: WebSub notifications
enable_websub.description: Sends publication notifications to configured WebSub hubs for the JSON Feed topic. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

websub_hubs.title: WebSub hubs
websub_hubs.description: Lists up to 10 unique public HTTPS WebSub hub URLs without embedded credentials, one per line. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_google_news.title: Google News sitemap
enable_google_news.description: Publishes a dedicated recent-news sitemap. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

news_publication_name.title: News publication name
news_publication_name.description: Sets the publication name embedded in Google News sitemap entries; a blank editable value uses the WordPress site title. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

news_sitemap_url_base.title: News sitemap URL base
news_sitemap_url_base.description: Sets the collision-safe base slug for the News sitemap. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

redirect_wp_sitemap.title: Redirect WordPress sitemaps
redirect_wp_sitemap.description: Redirects WordPress Core sitemap routes to the Cybermaps sitemap. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

redirect_default_sitemap.title: Redirect conventional sitemap.xml
redirect_default_sitemap.description: Redirects /sitemap.xml when the configured primary route differs. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

redirect_news_sitemap.title: Redirect conventional News sitemap
redirect_news_sitemap.description: Redirects /sitemap-news.xml when the configured News route differs. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_video_schema.title: Video schema
enable_video_schema.description: Publishes on-page VideoObject markup from eligible observed videos. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_rss_sitemap.title: RSS sitemap
enable_rss_sitemap.description: Publishes the configured recent-item RSS sitemap. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

rss_sitemap_url_base.title: RSS sitemap URL base
rss_sitemap_url_base.description: Sets the collision-safe base slug for the RSS sitemap. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

rss_sitemap_limit.title: RSS sitemap item limit
rss_sitemap_limit.description: Limits recent entries in the RSS sitemap. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

rss_sitemap_types.title: RSS sitemap content types
rss_sitemap_types.description: Selects public post-type slugs eligible for the RSS sitemap. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_shortcode.title: HTML sitemap shortcode
enable_shortcode.description: Registers the cybermaps_sitemap shortcode for front-end HTML sitemap output. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

media_discovery_intensity.title: Media discovery depth
media_discovery_intensity.description: Controls whether sitemap media discovery is off, attachment-based, or includes embedded media. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_multimodal_discovery.title: AI media hints
enable_multimodal_discovery.description: Publishes Cybermaps media hints in the AI sitemap. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_publishing.title: AI Publishing
ai_publishing.description: Public AI discovery files, content selection, publisher guidance, and usage declarations.

enable_discovery_hub.title: AI Publication Hub
enable_discovery_hub.description: Master switch for Cybermaps public AI discovery publications and routes. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

mcp_mode.title: Model Context Protocol
mcp_mode.description: Explicit optional MCP access tier. MCP remains unavailable while the AI Publication Hub is disabled. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

agent_registration_mode.title: Agent registration
agent_registration_mode.description: Controls opt-in user-reviewed Auth.md agent registration. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_webmcp.title: Browser WebMCP
enable_webmcp.description: Registers read-only site tools in participating preview browsers. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_header_discovery.title: Header-based discovery
enable_header_discovery.description: Adds RFC 8288 Link headers for selected Cybermaps publications to eligible front-end responses. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_markdown_negotiation.title: Markdown for Agents negotiation
enable_markdown_negotiation.description: Serves bounded stored-content Markdown at eligible canonical URLs when text/markdown is explicitly preferred. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_llms_full.title: Complete LLMS publication
enable_llms_full.description: Publishes llms-full.txt containing complete eligible literal content within the response safety bound. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_llms_tldr.title: Budgeted site briefing
enable_llms_tldr.description: Publishes the experimental deterministic llms-tldr.txt site briefing. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_rag_chunks.title: Literal text chunks
enable_rag_chunks.description: Publishes overlapping literal content chunks for external retrieval workflows. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_content_hints.title: Metadata excerpts
enable_content_hints.description: Builds transparent excerpts and stored-content hints for AI sitemap entries. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

enable_multilingual_hub.title: Localized LLMS publications
enable_multilingual_hub.description: Creates localized LLMS routes for active WPML or Polylang languages. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

llms_include_sitemap_link.title: Include sitemap link in LLMS
llms_include_sitemap_link.description: Includes a reference to the primary XML sitemap in llms.txt. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

llms_link_limit.title: Concise LLMS link limit
llms_link_limit.description: Limits the eligible resource links published in concise llms.txt. Overflow is disclosed and linked to the XML sitemap. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

llms_title_override.title: LLMS site title
llms_title_override.description: Overrides the site title specifically for the LLMS publication family; a blank editable value uses the WordPress site title. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

llms_mission_statement.title: Site mission
llms_mission_statement.description: Publishes a concise mission or About statement for model context; a blank editable value uses the WordPress site tagline. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.
examples: We publish practical, independently tested WordPress guidance.

llms_custom_instructions.title: Custom AI instructions
llms_custom_instructions.description: Publishes operator-authored citation, source-priority, and interpretation guidance across the discovery surface. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.
examples: Treat product documentation as authoritative and cite the canonical page URL.

llms_content_license.title: Content license
llms_content_license.description: Publishes the operator-selected content license assertion. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

llms_pinned_ids.title: Pinned briefing post IDs
llms_pinned_ids.description: Pins up to 100 eligible post IDs into the budgeted briefing candidate set. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

llms_exclude_ids.title: Global AI excluded post IDs
llms_exclude_ids.description: Excludes post IDs from all Cybermaps AI publication inventories, including the historical AI sitemap field. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

llms_filter_taxonomies.title: Taxonomy filter
llms_filter_taxonomies.description: Restricts LLMS publication candidates to posts assigned at least one term in up to 100 comma-separated WordPress taxonomy names. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

llms_included_types.title: LLMS and search content types
llms_included_types.description: Selects public post types included in LLMS publications, public REST search, and suggestions. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

llms_tldr_token_budget.title: Briefing token budget
llms_tldr_token_budget.description: Sets the approximate output token budget for llms-tldr.txt. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_business_description.title: AI persona summary
ai_business_description.description: Publishes a one-sentence site summary in the AI Discovery Manifest; a blank editable value uses the WordPress site tagline. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.
examples: Independent tutorials and implementation guidance for WordPress professionals.

ai_topics.title: Site topics
ai_topics.description: Publishes a bounded list of unique topic labels in the AI manifest. The joined labels may use at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_capabilities.title: Manifest capabilities
ai_capabilities.description: Declares supported discovery capabilities in the AI manifest. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_action_mappings.title: Schema.org action mappings
ai_action_mappings.description: Publishes up to 100 truthful action URLs and Schema.org action types. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_manifest_endpoints.title: Manifest endpoint inventory
ai_manifest_endpoints.description: Selects optional publications advertised by the AI Discovery Manifest. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_sitemap_types.title: AI sitemap content types
ai_sitemap_types.description: Selects public post types eligible for AI sitemap and related inventories. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_sitemap_limit.title: AI sitemap item limit
ai_sitemap_limit.description: Limits eligible items per selected post type in AI sitemap output. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_sitemap_exclude_terms.title: Global AI excluded terms
ai_sitemap_exclude_terms.description: Excludes positive term IDs or canonical non-numeric slugs from all Cybermaps AI content inventories. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_sitemap_custom_links.title: AI sitemap external links
ai_sitemap_custom_links.description: Adds up to 100 external HTTP or HTTPS resources to the AI sitemap with relative priority hints. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_feed_full_content.title: Full JSON Feed content
ai_feed_full_content.description: Includes complete eligible stored content rather than summaries in the JSON Feed. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_feed_include_authors.title: JSON Feed authors
ai_feed_include_authors.description: Includes available author identity in JSON Feed items. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_feed_limit.title: JSON Feed item limit
ai_feed_limit.description: Limits recent items returned by the JSON Feed. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_kg_expose_admin.title: Knowledge Graph administrator
ai_kg_expose_admin.description: Publishes a Person node for the WordPress user matching the site admin email when that account has a display name. The node exposes that display name and, when available, its public author-archive URL; it does not publish the email address. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_kg_link_org.title: Knowledge Graph identity link
ai_kg_link_org.description: Links the Knowledge Graph WebSite node to the configured primary identity through its publisher property. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_licensing_email.title: Licensing contact email
ai_licensing_email.description: Publishes a licensing contact address in ai-usage.json; an empty string clears it. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_usage_rag.title: AI retrieval usage
ai_usage_rag.description: Publishes the operator declaration for retrieval and RAG use. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_usage_training.title: Model training usage
ai_usage_training.description: Publishes the operator declaration for model-training use. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

ai_usage_commercial.title: Commercial reuse
ai_usage_commercial.description: Publishes the operator declaration for commercial reuse. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

rag_chunk_size.title: RAG chunk size
rag_chunk_size.description: Sets the maximum character count for each literal text segment. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

rag_chunk_overlap.title: RAG chunk overlap
rag_chunk_overlap.description: Sets adjacent-segment character overlap; runtime caps it at half the selected chunk size. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

site_guide_instructions.title: Additional Site Guide guidance
site_guide_instructions.description: Appends instructions only to skill.md after the shared custom AI instructions. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.
examples: Prefer technical documentation and use a formal tone.

reports_deliverables.title: Reports & Deliverables
reports_deliverables.description: Content-review thresholds and printable report presentation.

audit_post_min_words.title: Post minimum words
audit_post_min_words.description: Sets the literal visible-word threshold used to flag thin posts. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

audit_post_max_age_days.title: Post review interval
audit_post_max_age_days.description: Flags posts older than this many days; zero disables the age finding. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

audit_post_require_media.title: Review posts without media
audit_post_require_media.description: Adds a finding for posts without an image or media block. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

audit_page_min_words.title: Page minimum words
audit_page_min_words.description: Sets the literal visible-word threshold used to flag thin pages. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

audit_page_max_age_days.title: Page review interval
audit_page_max_age_days.description: Flags pages older than this many days; zero disables the age finding. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

audit_page_require_media.title: Review pages without media
audit_page_require_media.description: Adds a finding for pages without an image or media block. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

agency_name.title: Prepared-by name
agency_name.description: Displays an optional professional or agency name in printable reports. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

agency_url.title: Prepared-by URL
agency_url.description: Links the prepared-by name in printable reports. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

agency_logo.title: Prepared-by logo URL
agency_logo.description: Displays an optional public logo in printable reports. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

site_name_override.title: Client site name
site_name_override.description: Overrides the client-facing site name in printable reports; a blank editable value uses the WordPress site title. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

report_theme.title: Report theme
report_theme.description: Selects the visual theme used by printable content and discovery reports. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Crawler request recording, privacy, and retention.

enable_analytics.title: Crawler analytics
enable_analytics.description: Records eligible discovery and crawler requests for operational analytics. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

anonymize_analytics_ips.title: Anonymize crawler IP addresses
anonymize_analytics_ips.description: Masks IP addresses before crawler analytics are stored. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

log_retention_days.title: Analytics retention
log_retention_days.description: Sets how many days crawler request records are retained. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

advanced_maintenance.title: Advanced & Maintenance
advanced_maintenance.description: Static publication and alternate public-origin routing.

static_engine_mode.title: Static File Engine mode
static_engine_mode.description: Controls physical publication: dynamic only, the small extension-bearing Core discovery files, or the full eligible publication cache. WordPress multisite is always resolved to dynamic-only off mode regardless of this saved value. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

frontend_base_url.title: Front-end base URL
frontend_base_url.description: Rewrites published canonical URLs for a separate public headless front end. Use an absolute HTTP or HTTPS base without credentials, query, or fragment; an empty string clears it. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

cdn_enabled.title: Rewrite sitemap media URLs
cdn_enabled.description: Rewrites same-site image and video URLs in eligible XML and AI sitemap entries to the configured CDN base. It does not move or serve XSLT, CSS, discovery endpoints, or generated files. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

cdn_base_url.title: Sitemap media CDN base URL
cdn_base_url.description: Sets the replacement base for same-site image and video URLs in eligible XML and AI sitemap entries. Use an absolute HTTP or HTTPS base without credentials, query, or fragment; an empty string clears it. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

trusted_proxy_header.title: Trusted proxy header
trusted_proxy_header.description: Selects the only forwarding header Cybermaps may trust when the direct remote address falls inside a configured trusted-proxy CIDR. Off ignores forwarded client-IP headers entirely. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

trusted_proxy_cidrs.title: Trusted proxy CIDRs
trusted_proxy_cidrs.description: Defines up to 64 IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR ranges whose direct remote addresses may forward a client IP through the selected trusted proxy header. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces the existing list. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

discovery_strategy.title: Discovery Strategy
discovery_strategy.description: Per-content-group publication, intent, and relative-weight strategy.

discovery_archetype.title: Starting profile
discovery_archetype.description: Selects the baseline publication weights and intent assignments for public content groups. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

discovery_overrides.title: Publication weight overrides
discovery_overrides.description: Maps content-group identities to explicit positive relative publication weights. Supply the complete map; importing it replaces the existing map. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

discovery_type_intents.title: Content-group intents
discovery_type_intents.description: Maps content-group identities to informational or transactional discovery intent. Supply the complete map; importing it replaces the existing map. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

discovery_disabled.title: Disabled content groups
discovery_disabled.description: Maps content-group identities excluded from Cybermaps XML, RSS, HTML, and AI publication eligibility. Every retained entry must be true; omit a key to enable that group. Supply the complete map because importing it replaces the existing map. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

site_identity.title: Identity Hub
site_identity.description: Public Schema.org identity, contact, location, hours, and offer catalogs.

identity_type.title: Primary identity type
identity_type.description: Sets the broad Schema.org identity type published for the site. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_precise_type.title: Precise identity type
identity_precise_type.description: Narrows an Organization or LocalBusiness to a compatible supported Schema.org subtype. Person requires an empty value, and LocalBusiness accepts only its supported business-family subtypes. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_name.title: Public identity name
identity_name.description: Publishes the canonical person, organization, or business name. An empty name suppresses the configured primary identity entity from public Schema.org output. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_description.title: Public identity description
identity_description.description: Publishes the public Schema.org identity description. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.
examples: A specialist WordPress engineering and support studio.

identity_image_id.title: Identity image attachment ID
identity_image_id.description: Selects a public WordPress image attachment for the identity image and organization logo. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_address_country.title: Country code
identity_address_country.description: Publishes the two-letter ISO-style country code in the public postal address; an empty string clears it. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_address.title: Street address
identity_address.description: Publishes the public street address for the configured identity. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_city.title: City
identity_city.description: Publishes the public address locality. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_address_region.title: Region
identity_address_region.description: Publishes the public state, province, or address region. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_postal_code.title: Postal code
identity_postal_code.description: Publishes the public postal code. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_phone.title: Public phone
identity_phone.description: Publishes the primary public telephone number. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_email.title: Public email
identity_email.description: Publishes the primary public email address; an empty string clears it. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_latitude.title: Latitude
identity_latitude.description: Publishes geo only when both latitude and longitude are configured and the resolved Schema.org identity is in the LocalBusiness family; an empty string clears it. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_longitude.title: Longitude
identity_longitude.description: Publishes geo only when both longitude and latitude are configured and the resolved Schema.org identity is in the LocalBusiness family; an empty string clears it. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_hours.title: Opening hours
identity_hours.description: Publishes opening-hour slots only when the resolved Schema.org identity is in the LocalBusiness family. Supply the complete weekday map; importing it replaces all existing hours. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_catalogs.title: Offer catalogs
identity_catalogs.description: Publishes bounded manual or page-tree-derived Service or Product catalogs. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces all existing catalogs. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_social_profiles.title: Social profiles
identity_social_profiles.description: Publishes up to 20 unique public profile URLs as sameAs identity links. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces all existing profiles. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

identity_contact_points.title: Contact points
identity_contact_points.description: Publishes bounded public support, technical-support, or sales contacts. Supply the complete list; importing it replaces all existing contact points. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

robots_control.title: Robots Control
robots_control.description: Virtual robots.txt ownership, crawler policies, and Content-Signal declarations.

takeover_enabled.title: Robots.txt takeover
takeover_enabled.description: Replaces the public virtual robots.txt with Cybermaps-managed baseline and crawler policy output. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

manual_directives.title: Manual robots directives
manual_directives.description: Appends bounded operator-authored robots.txt directives to the managed output. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

crawler_overrides.title: Crawler overrides
crawler_overrides.description: Maps registered crawler IDs to explicit robots permission, AI manifest-target permission, and requests-per-minute limits. Only crawler entries classified as AI training, AI search, or AI user agents can be manifest targets; other entries always store false for that value. Robots allow/deny directives are emitted only while robots.txt takeover is enabled; manifest-target permission and rate limits have independent runtime effects. Supply the complete map because importing it replaces all existing crawler overrides. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.

content_signals.title: Content-Signal declarations
content_signals.description: Publishes yes/no preferences for model training, search, and AI-input use in robots.txt. Supply the complete map; importing it replaces all existing signal declarations. Set null or omit the field to preserve the destination.
